```python
    if task.get("lease") == "live":
        return "wait"
    
    state = task.get("state")

        return "retry"
    
    if state == "failed":
        attempts = task.get("attempts", 0)
        max_attempts = task.get("max_attempts", 0)
        
        if attempts < max_attempts:
            return "retry"
        else:
            return "escalate"

```
